title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts Level Entitlements
content:
Scheduling access, batch offers and support access differ by level on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts. The entitlements of a level apply from the date the account holds that level.

| Level | Early schedule access (hours before general release) | Head start on new batch offers | Orders carried in one batch (maximum) | Heavy-order batches offered | Stock-Up Delivery batches offered | Express 30 batches offered | Batches containing alcohol offered | Priority shopper-support queue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper | 0 | 0 seconds | 3 | No | No | No | No | No |
| Full-Service Shopper | 0 | 0 seconds | 3 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Full-Service Shopper Silver | 12 | 10 seconds | 3 | Yes | No | Yes | Yes | No |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | 24 | 20 seconds | 3 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 48 | 30 seconds | 4 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 72 | 45 seconds | 5 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Batches containing alcohol are offered only where the level offers them and only to a shopper who has reached the minimum age for alcohol batches.

## Questions answered from the table

- *From which level are Stock-Up Delivery batches offered?* From Full-Service Shopper Gold upward.
- *How many orders can a Full-Service Shopper Platinum carry in one batch?* Up to 4; Full-Service Shopper Diamond carries up to 5, and every other level up to 3.
- *Does a Full-Service Shopper Silver reach the priority shopper-support queue?* No; the queue opens at Full-Service Shopper Gold.
- *What head start does a Full-Service Shopper Diamond have on new offers?* 45 seconds, and 72 hours of early schedule access.
